paragraphs.text: The Cliffs of Kazuul are a guarded mountain passage into the continent of Murasa on Zendikar .

These cliffs represent the only maintained cliff-side ascent of the exterior of Murasa 's Wall. Set up by the Tajuru elves but now maintained mainly by humans, the Cliffs of Kazuul are named for Kazuul , the pass's current ruler, an ogre slave-master who demands tribute from any who seek passage. Those who pay (including a bribe to the lift operators at various points on the path) are allowed to traverse the steep zig-zagging trails cut into the cliffs between each harrowing vertical ascent using log-and-rope elevators. Those who reach the top without proper tribute for Kazuul are cast out—sometimes literally hurled to their deaths in the crashing ocean.
